selection.method: Source-only selection from public Claude Agent SDK Python repositories after PR #352 merged. HorusTrace output from this cohort was not used to select cases. One Anthropic workshop case is a reference conformance sentinel; eleven independent repositories test generalisation across direct construction, helper-returned options, class attributes, dynamic kwargs, typed MCP config, multi-agent delegation, hooks, and wrapper abstractions.
selection.interpretation: A coarse source-truth semantic holdout. Required feature checks are structural expectations, not a precision/recall accuracy score.

cases.source_signal: Official workshop builds ClaudeAgentOptions in build_options(), then passes the returned object to ClaudeSDKClient. Depending on toggles it attaches in-process SDK MCP servers, AgentDefinition subagents, hooks and bypassPermissions.
Client factory returns ClaudeSDKClient with inline ClaudeAgentOptions, built-in and MCP tool approval lists, multiple MCP servers and security hooks.
Small autonomous coding client returns ClaudeSDKClient configured with inline ClaudeAgentOptions, Playwright/features MCP servers, tool lists and a Bash security hook.
Method-local ClaudeAgentOptions enables Read/Write with acceptEdits and is consumed by ClaudeSDKClient in an async-with expression.
Production-shaped helper assembles an options_kwargs dictionary with hooks, tool budgets and optional MCP servers, then calls query() with ClaudeAgentOptions(**options_kwargs).
Query-based trading agent uses explicit ClaudeAgentOptions with bypassPermissions, built-ins plus MCP approvals, and a stdio Polymarket MCP server.
Direct query() example with three inline AgentDefinition subagents, bypassPermissions and a typed McpStdioServerConfig MongoDB server.
Interactive multi-agent research app defines two AgentDefinition subagents, Pre/PostToolUse hooks, Task approval and bypassPermissions before consuming options through ClaudeSDKClient async-with.
Agent class stores ClaudeAgentOptions on self, dynamically selects several stdio/http MCP servers, uses bypassPermissions, and later passes the attribute to query().

Large supervisor builds ClaudeAgentOptions in a helper from dynamically loaded AgentDefinition registry entries, credential-aware MCP registry and multiple audit/security hooks, then uses the options across client/query entry points.

Framework wrapper constructs opts = ClaudeAgentOptions with default bypassPermissions, dynamically loaded MCP/subagents/hooks, and later passes the returned object through RunnableClaudeAgent to ClaudeSDKClient.

Mode.options() returns ClaudeAgentOptions; MCP modes add a stdio roam server and all modes use bypassPermissions. Call sites construct ClaudeSDKClient from mode.options(...) rather than a simple option variable.
